setup.name: The setup
setup.text: During an experimental procedure, the healer realizes the patient's condition is far worse than expected.

choices.label: Follow the patient's previously expressed limits.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer completes the operation, but the patient dies days later.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient survives, though recovery is long and uncertain.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient survives the immediate crisis and later thanks the healer for stopping.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient dies, leaving the healer wondering whether more could have been done.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healer stops when the agreed boundary is reached.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healer proceeds only with the limited step the patient had authorized.
